bullets: Performed statutory audits in accordance with the Companies Act, 2013, ensuring integrity of general ledger balances, accuracy of transaction recording, and compliance with applicable accounting standards across manufacturing, trading, and service sectors.
Improved financial reporting reliability through detailed examination of accounts payable CWIP, and assessment of inventory controls and valuation practices.
Oversaw physical verification activities for key clients including Asian Paints, Care Alternatives, resulting in enhanced data accuracy, stronger internal controls, and a 20%
Concluded statutory audit reports for over 30 clients by compiling audit observations, with the Companies Act, CARO requirements, Standards on Auditing, and relevant regulatory
Assessed internal control environments by executing IFC walkthroughs, evaluating control Control Matrices, identifying gaps, and recommending corrective actions.
Executed GST and tax audit assignments across trading, retail, manufacturing, and finalization, ITC verification, GSTR reconciliation analysis, and statutory adherence.
Administered the complete filing lifecycle of 100+ Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for accuracy, timeliness, and full regulatory compliance.
Drafted detailed submissions in response to various income tax assessment and scrutiny and assessment outcomes.
Addressed complex GST notices, including high-value matters, and supported documentation
Compiled complete sets of financial statements for more than 50 clients in accordance timely reporting.
